Breath of the Dragonair Part 3 (Japanese: VS ハクリュー【後編】 VS (Part 3)) is the 62nd chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 22nd chapter of the .

==Plot==
 
Lance throws Pika back to and has his around Yellow, immobilizing Yellow. He tells Yellow that he is in the Elite Four and can control s. To prove this, he commands his Dragonair to . Pika tries to attack Lance, but stops when Dragonair's narrowly misses it. The beam then changes direction and hits Pika. It falls into the ocean. Lance reassures Yellow that he held back, so Pika won't die. He then sees the scar on Pika's ear, and he knows that the is Pika. The Elite Four has found Pika. Lance's Dragonair drops Yellow and wraps around Pika. Yellow tells Pika to use , and Pika creates a double that attacks Lance but misses. Enraged, Lance has his Dragonair use , and Dragonair blasts Yellow, Pika, and its double, making them fall into the ocean. While underwater, Yellow notes that Pika's double repels water, and gets an idea.

Lance hears something, and he turns around to see Yellow surfing with the help of Pika who had learned . Pika uses on Lance, causing a giant explosion and Lance to disappear. Yellow, having apparently defeated Lance, starts to go to "the city at the other end of the sea". Behind Yellow, bubbles start to rise to the water's surface.

==Major events==

battles Lance of the Kanto Elite Four and seemingly defeats him.
